components.scenario: Initial public offering, excluding the underwriters’ over-allotment option; reflects the planned reclassification into a single class of ordinary shares and 3.3269-for-1 share split.

over_allotment.scenario: Underwriters may purchase up to this number of additional shares within 30 days from the prospectus date to cover over-allotments, at the initial public offering price less underwriting discounts and commissions.

post_offering_os.scenario: After the offering, assuming no exercise of the over-allotment option and an offering price of $17.00 per share; gives effect to the Reclassification and 3.3269-for-1 Share Split and excludes shares issuable under outstanding options and reserved under equity incentive plans.

After the offering, assuming full exercise of the over-allotment option and an offering price of $17.00 per share; gives effect to the Reclassification and 3.3269-for-1 Share Split and excludes shares issuable under outstanding options and reserved under equity incentive plans.

proceeds.scenario: Approximately, assuming an initial public offering price of $17.00 per ordinary share and no exercise of the over-allotment option, after estimated underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses payable by the issuer.

Approximately, assuming an initial public offering price of $17.00 per ordinary share and full exercise of the over-allotment option, after estimated underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses payable by the issuer.

Total consideration to be paid to the issuer by new investors for 100,000,000 ordinary shares at an assumed initial public offering price of $17.00 per share, before estimated underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses.
